manual_decisions.kakapo: Corrected spelling to Strigops habroptilus following IUCN, iNaturalist and New Zealand conservation usage; GBIF retains Strigops habroptila.
manual_decisions.longsnout-catfish: Retained the IUCN-assessed Leiocassis longirostris combination; GBIF treats it as a synonym and iNaturalist has no exact indexed taxon.
